en.headline: Man arrested over suspected poisoning of stray cats in Shek Kip Mei Park
en.dek: Police arrested a 34-year-old man early on Saturday after volunteers said they caught him placing suspected rat poison in cat food at Shek Kip Mei Park.
body: Police said a 34-year-old man was arrested early on Saturday on suspicion of cruelty to animals and possession of an offensive weapon after he was stopped at Shek Kip Mei Park.

Animal welfare volunteers said they had noticed black sludge and suspected rat poison mixed into food left for stray cats in the park since mid-August. They installed cameras and, early on Saturday, intercepted a man they said had been adding material to the feeding spots. Police found a packet of suspected rat bait and a fruit knife about 14 centimetres long on the man.

The man was taken into custody for investigation. The case was handed to the Sham Shui Po District Crime Squad. No cats were reported injured in the incident. Volunteers said the man had been seen adding material to the food on previous occasions.

zh.headline: 石砫尾公園疑投毒害貓 34歲男涉殘酷對待動物被捕
zh.dek: 警方今日凌晨在石砫尾公園拘捕一名34歲男子，身上檢獲懷疑老鼠藥及一把約14厘米長的生果刀。
body: 警方表示，今日凌晨在石砫尾公園近網球場一空地拘捕一名34歲何姓男子，涉嫌殘酷對待動物及藏有攻擊性武器。
動物保護組織及義工稱，自8月中旬起發現公園內餵飼流浪貓的糧兜被混入黑色污泥狀物體及懷疑老鼠藥。他們裝設閉路電視監察，今日凌晨發現該名男子在糧兜「加料」後將其截停並報警。警方在男子身上搜獲一包懷疑老鼠藥及一把連手柄約14厘米長的生果刀。
案件交由深水埗警區刑事調查隊第三隊跟進，男子現正被扣留調查。現場未有貓隻受傷。義工表示，該名男子早前已多次在深夜出現並在糧兜加料。
